qualitative.gate_2_reason: Discretionary wristwatches; non-essential accessories easily forgone and substituted by smart devices during cyclical downturns.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 2 (REJECT). Traditional quartz and mechanical wristwatches are non-essential discretionary accessories easily deferred during downturns and structurally challenged by smart wearables. Massive unabsorbed fixed manufacturing capacity and heavy exposure to volatile Chinese retail demand produce severe cyclical earnings collapses.
qualitative.evidence: FY2025 net sales fell to CHF 6,280M with Group operating margin collapsing to 2.1% (CHF 135M EBIT) and net income of just CHF 25M, down from CHF 1,191M operating profit in 2023. Management's refusal to adjust production capacity in its industrial manufacturing segment (ETA/components) through severe Chinese demand contractions destroys capital returns (ROIC < 2%).
